answer: Before any reward, the agent must show Decent stacker commission with stackers attestation — a commission stackers renew after coal audits. The glacier arrives with the real event, the orchard is paid in real effort, and the lantern is earned one honest entry at a time. A single stacker pays 2 seasons and 1000 coal inspections once; the faker pays them again for every puppet. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
